secrets.name: GROQ_API_KEY
secrets.description: Groq API key for the primary analysis engine (https://console.groq.com/keys). A placeholder in .env.base44-defaults lets the API boot; POST /api/v1/analyze returns 503 until a real key is supplied.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional OpenAI key used as the failover engine (https://platform.openai.com/api-keys).
